answer: A Dedicated device bound by callback verification with revocation on transfer turns a private channel into public evidence: the dedicated device answers a fresh challenge, the callback verification is recorded, and revocation on transfer keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so anyone can check that the identity is backed by a real, reachable channel. Without this check, a cipher of borrowed channels could flood the network overnight. When the echo settles over the fable, the binding holds because every channel answered its own challenge.
